notes.title: Neave Version 1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed bug causing the music to not loop correctly
[*]Fixed bug with Settings Menu not closing when pressing the escape key or menu button
[/list]

notes.title: Neave Version 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37036519/37e358cd3be4a6e687b10a7add1358c30f6f325b.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Added ability to rebind keys
[*]Add ability to toggle V-Sync
[*]Added Field Of View slider
[*]Fixed bug with Audio. Audio will now turn off completely at 0%
[*]Scoring system updated to display minutes, seconds, and milliseconds [00 : 00 : 00]
[*]Fixed bug where holding the jump button in water would cause repeated jumping
[*]Removed camera relative movement while swimming
[*]Added ability to quickly restart the game (keybinding)
[*]Switched the slide controls to be "hold to slide" instead of the toggle
[*]Increased HUD visibility
[*]Various small UI changes
[*]Slight adjustment of one block's position
[/list]
